init.title: NeoLight settings
init.description: Choose what you want to configure.

entrances.title: Entrances and video
entrances.description: Configure the camera and, when an account is linked, the video input and door controls.

data.preferred_video_channel: Preferred video channel (0 keeps the device selection)
data.route_video_on_ring: Switch video to the call channel when ringing
data.call_video_channel: Monitor channel during a call (DOOR/CAM; 0 disables switching)
data.call_video_hold_seconds: Keep call video for this many seconds

calls.title: Calls
calls.description: Enable the incoming doorbell event. Call controls appear when their bridge is configured.

automatic_opening.title: Automatic opening
automatic_opening.description: Choose when a fresh call may open a verified door. The one-time test expires after 15 minutes.

data.auto_unlock_test_once: Unlock once on the next ring (armed for 15 minutes)
data.hangup_after_auto_unlock: End the call after automatic door release

apple_home.title: Apple Home
apple_home.description: Connect the HomeKit doorbell notification bridge.

advanced.title: Advanced media
advanced.description: Manual RTSP and media settings for installations that need them.

data.native_call_control_port: Native bridge call control port (0 disables End call)

account.title: NeoLight account
account.description: Update the account paired with this monitor. Leave the password blank to keep it.

link_account.title: Link NeoLight account
link_account.description: Optional advanced setup. Paste a profile from your own app installation, then sign in to enable calls and door controls. Local video keeps working if you skip this step.

error.invalid_account: Enter a valid email, password, and country code
error.cannot_auth: Cannot sign in or access the paired device
error.invalid_call_video_channel: Choose a call video channel to enable automatic switching
error.invalid_call_control_port: Set the native call control port to enable automatic hangup
error.doorbell_required: Enable doorbell events before automatic opening
error.invalid_auto_unlock_relay: Enable the selected door control before automatic opening
error.invalid_bridge_health_url: Enter an HTTP(S) bridge health URL
error.invalid_profile: App profile JSON is missing required fields or is malformed

user.title: Connect NeoLight monitor
user.description: Enter the monitor address. The stream UUID is optional if you will provide a camera RTSP URL on the next screen or later in Configure.

connection.title: Choose how to connect
connection.description: Start with the local monitor. Cloud calls and door controls can be linked later in Configure.

local.title: Local camera
local.description: Optional: enter a shared RTSP bridge URL. If you already entered a stream UUID, you can leave this empty. You can add or change the camera URL later in Configure.

cloud.title: NeoLight app and media
cloud.description: Advanced setup: use a profile from your own app installation for cloud calls and door release. Account credentials and app profile stay in Home Assistant private storage.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot identify the NeoLight monitor at this address
error.invalid_account: Enter a valid email, password, and country code
error.cannot_auth: Cannot sign in or access the paired device
error.invalid_profile: App profile JSON is missing required fields or is malformed

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one monitor per Home Assistant installation is supported
